summary.name: DeepL Translator
summary.one_liner: DeepL Translator is a web-based AI translation tool for typed text, voice, and full document files (PDF, Word, PowerPoint), with enterprise options for business use.
use_cases: translate PDF, Word, or PowerPoint files
integrating translation into business systems via API
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a translator where users type or paste text, or drag and drop PDF, Word (.docx), and PowerPoint (.pptx) files to translate them while preserving original formatting and layout. It offers voice translation for virtual meetings or in-person conversations. Business features mentioned include glossaries, rules, style and tone adaptations for writing, and an API for integrating its Language AI into systems. The page says its specialized LLM was trained on proprietary data by language experts, and it lists enterprise customer case studies such as Sumitomo Corporation, Merck KGaA, and Daiwa Securities.
notable: Document translation for PDF, Word (.docx), and PowerPoint (.pptx) files while preserving formatting and layout
Real-time voice translation for virtual meetings and in-person conversations
Glossaries, rules, and tone/style control for business writing
API for integrating Language AI into enterprise systems
caveats: Pro and enterprise features such as glossaries, rules, and API access are implied to be paid, but pricing is not stated on the page
The page does not list supported languages or file size limits
